note: Measured by tools/art/walk_fix/build_fixed_compare.py on 2026-10-26 with the same definitions as measurements.json. RD = the in-game male atlas; pixellab = the FIXED atlas built by compose_walk.py from the raw PixelLab atlas; pixellab_raw_summary = the raw atlas, re-measured here.

definitions.bbox: opaque bounding box [x0, y0, x1, y1] in the 80x80 cell, inclusive
definitions.foot_y: lowest opaque row; the game anchors y=72
definitions.pale_debris: opaque pixel with HSV saturation < 0.15 and value > 0.85 whose colour is more than 24 RGB units from every colour in the reference frame; share = debris px / opaque px
definitions.dark_outline_share: boundary pixels (opaque, with a transparent 4-neighbour) whose HSV value < 0.3, over all boundary pixels
definitions.palette_to_reference: Euclidean RGB distance from each unique colour (or each opaque pixel, weighted) to the nearest colour of the reference frame
definitions.hist_similarity_to_f0: histogram intersection of 4-bit-per-channel RGB histograms of opaque pixels, frame vs frame 0 of the same row (1.0 = same colour mix)
definitions.loop_seam_ratio: difference f7 to f0 divided by the mean difference of neighbours f0-f1 ... f6-f7; difference = share of pixels in the union silhouette that change alpha or colour. Near 1 means the loop closes as smoothly as any other step
definitions.height_consistency: max minus min of the per-direction median bbox height
definitions.faults.f1_satchel: satchel lane's template measure: share of the bag patch drawn at its tracked place (torso registration within +-3 px against the raw key frame); strap_px = leather pixels on the strap line (back rows)
definitions.faults.f2_bob: bbox top row per frame; range = max minus min over the 8 frames
definitions.faults.f3_turn_height: standing head top = frame 0 bbox top; highest = min bbox top over 8 frames
definitions.faults.f4_eyes: colour lane's blue_px: OKLab hue 235-305, chroma >= 0.05, L >= 0.2, in the top 47% of the figure; side lenses = colour lane's lens_stats
definitions.faults.f5_legs: leg lane's measure_row (foot rows, distinct foot configurations, leg-zone shape change between neighbours)
definitions.faults.f6_head_redraw: head lane's head_pairs: share of head pixels that differ between neighbouring frames after the best whole-head shift
definitions.faults.f7_colour: unique opaque colours per frame and per row; maroon = colour lane's maroon_stats below the hips
definitions.faults.craft: alpha values present, frames touching the 80x80 cell edge, lowest foot row, enclosed transparent holes

registration.note: No new registration. The fixed atlas keeps the raw atlas's per-direction translation (see measurements.json); every lane works in place on the 80x80 cells.

direction_mapping.rd_mirror_note: In the RD atlas, right and up_right are exact horizontal mirrors of left and up_left (0 differing pixels in all 16 frames); down_right is drawn separately. RD has 6 drawn directions, PixelLab drew all 8.
